title: Incrementality needs a counterfactual
hook: Two stated cases: explore the purchases assumed to occur without recommendations.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the purchases assumed to occur without recommendations affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Effect, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the purchases assumed to occur without recommendations in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
